title: Darrell "Housh" Doucette thinks "one or two" NFL players could make U.S. men's Olympic flag team

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Darrell "Housh" Doucette thinks "one or two" NFL players could make U.S. men's Olympic flag team
sources.description: Two years ago, flag-football star Darrell "Housh" Doucette said he'd be a better option for the Olympics than Patrick Mahomes.
